([[Easton, California]]) | college = *[[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] (1998–1999) *[[Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball|Fresno State]] (2000–2002) | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 27 | draft_year = 2002 | draft_team = [[Los Angeles Lakers]] | career_start = 2002 | career_end = 2004 | career_number = 1, 32, 6 | career_position = [[Small forward]] / [[shooting guard]] | years1 = {{nbay|2002|start}}–{{nbay|2003|start}} | team1 = [[Toronto Raptors]] | years2 = {{nbay|2003|full=y}} | team2 = [[Chicago Bulls]] | highlights = * First-team All-[[Western Athletic Conference|WAC]] (2001) | bbr = jeffech01 }} '''Christopher Allen Jefferies''' (born February 13, 1980) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played for the [[Toronto Raptors]] and the [[Chicago Bulls]] in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]] and [[Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball|Fresno State Bulldogs]]. ==College career== Jefferies was named First Team All-[[Western Athletic Conference]], All-Defensive Team and All-Newcomer Team as a sophomore at [[California State University, Fresno|Fresno State University]]. Also named WAC Newcomer of the Year by the conference media. Jefferies had transferred from the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] following his freshman year. ==Professional career== Selected in the first round (27th overall pick) of the [[2002 NBA draft]] out of Fresno State by the [[Los Angeles Lakers]], his draft rights were traded along with [[Lindsey Hunter]] to the [[Toronto Raptors]] for [[Tracy Murray]] and the draft rights to [[Kareem Rush]]. He was later traded to the [[Chicago Bulls]] during the [[2003-04 NBA season|2003–04 season]]. Jefferies' final NBA game was played on April 14, 2004, in a 96–101 loss to the [[Indiana Pacers]] where he recorded 2 points and 5 fouls as the Bulls' starting Small Forward. In his short NBA career, Jefferies registered 72 games played, 12 game starts, and averaged 3.9 points and 1.2 rebounds per game.
